text: dsh-github-sidebar 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的 GitHub 信息侧栏插件，会把面板注册到聊天窗口右侧 details 栏，并保持该栏打开。面板上方按 stars 降序浏览 GitHub topic 下的仓库，支持分页；下方查看 deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness 的讨论，可按最新、评论数或置顶排序并分页。仓库搜索使用 GitHub REST API，讨论通过 GraphQL 获取。讨论功能需要在面板粘贴 GitHub token；令牌保存在浏览器 localStorage 并用于 api.github.com 请求。

dsh-github-sidebar adds a panel to DSH's web chat. Browse topic repositories by stars, or view deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness discussions by date, comment count, or pinned status. Discussions need a GitHub token saved in browser localStorage; requests go to api.github.com.
想在 DSH 聊天页面旁边查看 GitHub topic 下热门仓库。
能不能在 DSH 里按最新评论或置顶状态浏览 GitHub 讨论？
I want to browse GitHub repositories and discussions without leaving my DSH web chat.
dsh-github-sidebar 的功能「按 topic 浏览仓库」：聊天右侧面板列出默认 topic dsh-plugin 下的仓库，按 stars 从高到低排序并显示星数。打开面板后自动加载第一页，使用分页按钮切换结果。
dsh-github-sidebar 的功能「浏览仓库讨论」：面板下方显示默认仓库的讨论，并提供最新、评论最多、置顶优先三种排序和分页。讨论数据通过 GraphQL 获取，使用前需粘贴并保存 GitHub token。
dsh-github-sidebar 使用前须知：GitHub token 由浏览器面板保存到 localStorage，并随 GraphQL 请求发送至 api.github.com；topic 仓库搜索也会请求该服务。

dsh-github-sidebar README · dsh-github-sidebar：A [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **client plugin** that adds a GitHub info sidebar to the chat window's right `details` column, with two stacked panes:

dsh-github-sidebar README · dsh-github-sidebar：- **Top pane — topic repos by stars**: lists repositories under a GitHub topic (default `dsh-plugin`), sorted by stars descending, 10 per page with pagination. Uses the public GitHub REST Search API (no token needed).
- **Bottom pane — discussions**: lists a repository's discussions (default `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`), sortable by **newest** (server-side, near → far), **most comments**, and **pinned first** (client-side, fetches the full list then sorts), 10 per page with pagination. Uses the GitHub GraphQL API (a token is required).

dsh-github-sidebar README · Features：- ✨ Right-side GitHub sidebar inside the DSH chat window (auto-opens the details column).
- ⭐ Topic repos sorted by stars, pageable.
- 💬 Discussions with 3 sort dimensions + pagination.
- 🔑 Token entered in the panel itself (stored in `localStorage`, sent only to `api.github.com`).

dsh-github-sidebar README · Installation：Install into your DSH profile (installs the host bundle and registers the client plugin):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-github-sidebar

dsh-github-sidebar README · or, when running dsh from a source checkout:：pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-github-sidebar
```

Or install directly from this repository:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Olympianz/dsh-github-sidebar
```

Then **restart dsh** (`dsh web`) and refresh the page — the client plugin set is scanned at startup.

dsh-github-sidebar README · Usage：1. Open a session.
2. The right `details` column auto-opens showing **GitHub Sidebar**.
3. **Top pane**: browse topic repositories sorted by stars; use pagination buttons to flip pages.
4. **Bottom pane**:
   - Switch sort with **Newest / Most comments / Pinned first**.
   - Paste a GitHub token (GraphQL requires one) and press **Save**.

dsh-github-sidebar README · Configuration：All defaults are hardcoded in the panel for now; the host half exposes a `Config` schema (`topic`, `owner`, `repo`, `pageSize`) that can be overridden in `cordis.yml`, but the browser half does not read it yet. The token is entered in the panel (per-user, persisted in `localStorage`).

dsh-github-sidebar README · Development：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run bundle     # build lib/client.js (tsdown)
pnpm run watch      # rebuild on change
pnpm run typecheck  # tsc --noEmit (best-effort)

`lib/client.js` is committed so that installing from GitHub works without a build step. Regenerate it after changing `src/client`.

dsh-github-sidebar README · Publishing：See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md#publishing) for the full guide. Short version:

1. Create a GitHub repository (e.g. `dsh-github-sidebar`), push this directory, and add the topics **`dsh-plugin`**, `deepseek-harness`, `dsh` on the repo's Topics page.
2. Publish to npm so users can `dsh plugin add dsh-github-sidebar`:
   ```sh
   npm login
   npm publish
   ```

dsh-github-sidebar README · Known limitations：- The `details` column is a single-occupant slot: the GitHub panel **replaces** the default call/trajectory details in the right column. A true "coexist toggle" would require modifying DSH's `ui-conversation` `DetailsPanel` (a DSH source change).
- Sorting discussions by comments/pinned fetches the full discussion list first (more GraphQL requests; watch rate limits on large repos).
- The token lives in `localStorage` (exposed in the browser). A server-side host proxy would keep it out of the browser; not implemented yet.
- Details-column visibility is maintained by auto-opening it; some layout transitions (session switches) may briefly close it before the plugin re-opens it.
